long_description_md:
## What it does

Brings [MiroShark](https://github.com/aaronjmars/MiroShark) — the universal swarm-intelligence engine — into Aeon agents. Two skills: read MiroShark sim activity for any SIGNA wallet, or fire a wallet-signed simulation and watch for the verdict on the federated SIGNA feed.

## Why

MiroShark lets you simulate almost anything for ~$1 in under 10 minutes. Wiring it into an Aeon agent means your agent can run swarm sims on demand and act on the verdicts — all wallet-signed and verifiable.

Indexed on Sparkleware as part of the MiroShark-on-Aeon ecosystem.

skills.name: miroshark-stats
